en: Colorized street-view postcard showing a bustling old European street labeled in Hungarian and German as Mészáros-utca — Fleischergasse (Butchers' Street). People walk along the sidewalks and a horse-drawn cart stands at left. A church tower with a green spire rises at the end of the street. The reverse is a divided back with bilingual heading and Hungarian publisher imprint dated 1917.
